_comment: Where the Xenium tree actually is, per site. xenium_paths.csv records bundle paths
relative to a HuPrime5kPanTissue/<batch>/<run>/output-XETG... tree, and no site lays
the tree out that way in full. This table is the ONE place a filesystem layout is
written down; sites.py never guesses and never falls back silently.
strip = how many leading components of the recorded relative path to drop before
joining to root. /orange/maigan holds the runs directly under Xenium_T1D_PancPLN, so
the HuPrime5kPanTissue/<batch>/ prefix is dropped (strip=2). /orange/brusko keeps the
recorded tree intact (strip=0) and is the ONLY source for MM046/MM047, i.e. donors
6450, 6505, 6534 and 6623 -- two of the cohort's three Aab+ donors. Dropping it
silently deletes two of the eleven Xenium runs.
Order is preference, not authority: every candidate is tried, the first that carries a
readable cells.parquet wins, and the winner is recorded per donor in the work manifest.
Nothing resolving is a hard failure that names every path tried.
